correction: Earlier federation reports checked final SHA256 in the verifier, while the backend only checked declared length/range. This slice adds actual runtime length and SHA256 verification before successful file response headers. Earlier evidence remains scoped to its original source.

runtime.scope: Room/event-proven download path only; legacy local index download contract remains unchanged
runtime.method: Stream the complete object into a private temporary file, verify actual byte count and SHA256, recheck active home identity and current room/governance authorization, then stream verified bytes to the client
runtime.failure: Bad bytes become non-2xx no-store JSON responses before file Content-Disposition or binary body is sent. Existing client response.ok checks prevent successful blob caching.
runtime.range: Verify the whole object first, then serve the requested range from the verified file. An isolated range is not represented as an independent proof of whole-file SHA256.

limits.aggregateDiskBudget: per-file limit × concurrency, including retained orphan files; only files created by this request are removed
limits.apply: Core restart; independent of upload limit

checks.level: Real Core HTTP endpoint with synthetic Matrix HTTP byte source
cases: correct full bytes, absent length and compressed transport
same-length wrong bytes rejected as 502 JSON
headerless overflow and cleanly terminated truncation rejected
Range request detects corruption outside its requested interval
per-file cap and retained-file storage budget
service stopping aborts staged transfer and cleans its file

checks.level: Syntax, strict chat/admin TS7, full module regression including legacy media compatibility

checks.command: node scripts/federation-lab.mjs reload && node scripts/federation-lab.mjs verify

limitations: Actual malicious-byte cases use a controlled Matrix HTTP fixture; real Synapse covers valid federated object and Range transfers
Every new proven Range request fetches and verifies a complete upstream object; no shared verification cache is claimed
Previously copied history, known media references and downloaded bytes are not erased by revocation
publication: Local commit only; no package publication
